name: Magnific Connector
description: Full access to your own Magnific (formerly Freepik API) account: AI image generation (Mystic, Flux family, Seedream, Z-Image, RunWay), video generation (Kling, Hailuo, WAN, RunWay, LTX, Seedance, PixVerse, OmniHuman, VFX), image editing (Creative/Precision upscaling, relight, style transfer, background removal, expand), audio (music generation, sound effects, audio isolation), team credit/usage analytics, and stock content search (images, icons, videos). Bring-your-own-account (BYOK): connect your own Magnific API key, every call spends your own credits.

tools.name: connect_magnific
tools.description: Connect Magnific by saving your API key, after checking it actually works. Get a key from magnific.com: User menu -> Organization Settings -> API Keys.

api_key.description: Magnific API key to validate and save for this user. Get it from magnific.com > user menu > Organization Settings > API Keys.
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_magnific
tools.description: Disconnect Magnific: deletes the saved API key. Existing generation history recorded here is kept.

params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_magnific_connection

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Read your Magnific team's current credit usage/balance for the current billing period -- the first thing to check before a big generation batch.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate styled image(s) with a chosen Magnific model (Mystic, Flux family, Seedream, Z-Image, RunWay T2I). Async -- returns a task_id; poll with get_image_task until status is 'done'.

model.description: Which model to use: 'mystic' (default, most realistic), 'flux-2-pro', 'flux-2-turbo', 'flux-2-klein', 'flux-pro-v1-1', 'flux-dev', 'hyperflux', 'flux-kontext-pro', 'seedream-4', 'seedream-4-5', 'z-image', 'runway-t2i'. See list_image_models for the full catalog.
model.title: Model

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio hint, e.g. 'square_1_1', 'classic_4_3', 'widescreen_16_9', 'social_story_9_16'. Ignored by models that use pixel width/height instead -- see list_image_models for which each model actually accepts.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

num_images.description: How many images to generate in one call (model-dependent, max 4).
num_images.title: Num Images

reference_image_url.description: Optional publicly reachable reference/input image URL, for models that support image-to-image or image references (e.g. Flux Kontext Pro, Flux 2 Klein).
reference_image_url.title: Reference Image Url

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS callback URL Magnific POSTs the result to (HMAC-signed) instead of requiring you to poll get_image_task. Leave empty to poll manually.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

tools.name: get_image_task
tools.description: Poll an image generation task's status. Returns image URLs once status is 'done'.

model.description: The model id the task was created with, e.g. 'mystic', 'flux-2-pro'.
model.title: Model

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video with a chosen Magnific model (Kling, Hailuo, WAN, RunWay, Seedance, PixVerse). Async and often slow (minutes) -- returns a task_id; poll with get_video_task, or pass webhook_url for a callback instead.

model.description: Which video model to use, e.g. 'kling-2.5-pro', 'kling-2.1-master', 'hailuo-2.3', 'wan-2.6', 'runway-gen4-turbo', 'runway-gen4-aleph', 'ltx-2', 'seedance-v1-pro', 'pixverse-v5', 'omnihuman', 'vfx-1'. See list_video_models for the full catalog.
model.title: Model

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video/motion to generate. Required unless image_url alone drives an image-to-video model.
prompt.title: Prompt

image_url.description: Publicly reachable source image URL, required by image-to-video models (e.g. 'kling-2.5-pro', 'wan-2.5-i2v') and optional first-frame guidance for others.
image_url.title: Image Url

duration_seconds.description: Requested clip duration in seconds. Each model has its own supported range/step -- an out-of-range value is rejected by Magnific with a clear error.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the output video, e.g. 'widescreen_16_9', 'social_story_9_16', 'square_1_1'.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS callback URL for async completion instead of polling get_video_task. Recommended for video -- jobs can take minutes.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

tools.name: get_video_task
tools.description: Poll a video generation task's status. Returns video URLs once status is 'done'.

model.description: The model id the task was created with, e.g. 'kling-2.5-pro'.
model.title: Model

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale an image 2x/4x/8x/16x with Magnific's exclusive Creative engine (can add/infer new detail, supports a guiding prompt) or Precision engine (faithful super-resolution, no hallucination -- best for logos, UI, text, product photos). Async -- poll with get_edit_task.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image to upscale.
image_url.title: Image Url

mode.description: 'creative' (Magnific's exclusive engine -- can add/infer new detail, supports prompt+style) or 'precision' (faithful super-resolution, no hallucination -- best for logos, UI, text, product photos).
mode.title: Mode

prompt.description: Optional creative-mode prompt to guide added detail/style.
prompt.title: Prompt

tools.name: relight_image
tools.description: Change an image's lighting (direction/mood) with Magnific's relighting model. Async -- poll with get_edit_task.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image to relight.
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: Optional description of the desired lighting (e.g. 'golden hour, warm rim light').
prompt.title: Prompt

tools.name: style_transfer_image
tools.description: Apply a reference image's visual style to a source image. Async -- poll with get_edit_task.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the source image.
image_url.title: Image Url

style_reference_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the style reference image.
style_reference_url.title: Style Reference Url

strength.description: How strongly to apply the reference style (0=subtle, 1=full).
strength.title: Strength

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image, leaving a transparent PNG. Async -- poll with get_edit_task.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image to remove the background from.
image_url.title: Image Url

tools.name: expand_image
tools.description: Expand (outpaint) an image's canvas in any direction, optionally guided by a prompt for the new area. Async -- poll with get_edit_task.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image to expand (outpaint).
image_url.title: Image Url

prompt.description: Optional description of what should appear in the newly expanded area.
prompt.title: Prompt

target_aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio after expansion, e.g. 'widescreen_16_9', 'classic_4_3'.
target_aspect_ratio.title: Target Aspect Ratio

tools.name: get_edit_task
tools.description: Poll an image editing task (upscale/relight/style transfer/remove background/expand). Returns result URLs once status is 'done'.

operation.description: The edit operation the task was created with, e.g. 'upscale', 'relight'.
operation.title: Operation

task_id.description: Task id returned by the edit call.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate a music track from a text description. Async -- poll with get_audio_task.

prompt.description: Description of the music to generate, e.g. 'upbeat corporate background track, 30s'.
prompt.title: Prompt

tools.name: generate_sound_effect
tools.description: Generate a short sound effect from a text description. Async -- poll with get_audio_task.

prompt.description: Description of the sound effect, e.g. 'glass shattering on concrete'.
prompt.title: Prompt

tools.name: isolate_audio
tools.description: Isolate vocals/speech from background noise/music in an audio or video file. Async -- poll with get_audio_task.

audio_url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the audio/video file to isolate vocals/speech from background noise/music.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

tools.name: get_audio_task
tools.description: Poll an audio generation/isolation task (music/sound_effect/audio_isolation). Returns result URLs once status is 'done'.

operation.description: The audio operation the task was created with: 'music', 'sound_effect', or 'isolate'.
operation.title: Operation

task_id.description: Task id returned by the audio generation call.
task_id.title: Task Id

tools.name: search_stock_content
tools.description: Search Magnific's stock content library -- 'images' (photos & templates), 'icons', or 'videos' -- by free-text query.

query.description: Search term, e.g. 'business meeting', 'summer sale banner'.
query.title: Query

tools.name: list_generation_results
tools.description: List your past generation/edit/video actions with filters by type, status, date range -- this connector's own locally-tracked history (Magnific has no cross-model 'list all my tasks' endpoint).

kind.description: Optional filter: 'image', 'video', 'edit', or 'audio'. Empty = all kinds.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Max number of records to return, most recent first.
limit.title: Limit

GenerationRecord.description:
One locally-tracked generation call, so `list_generation_results`
can show a real history even though Magnific itself does not expose a
'list all my past tasks' endpoint across every model.
GenerationRecord.title: GenerationRecord

secrets.name: magnific_api_key
secrets.description: Your Magnific API key, from magnific.com > user menu > Organization Settings > API Keys. Spent against your own credit balance on every generation call.
